meta.title: Travel eSIM — instant data, no roaming surprises
meta.description: Buy a travel eSIM in minutes. Instant data for more than 100 destinations, installs with a single QR scan, no roaming charges.

brand.guarantee: Full refund if the eSIM is never installed.

home.heroTitle: Travel data, without the roaming surprise.
home.heroSubtitle: Pick a destination, pay in your currency, and scan a QR code to get online before you land.
home.howItWorksStep1Body: Make sure your phone supports eSIM and is carrier-unlocked.
home.howItWorksStep2Body: Choose a data plan for your trip. Pay with card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayNow, Alipay or WeChat Pay.
home.howItWorksStep3Body: Scan your QR code to install the eSIM, then switch it on when you land.

country.intro: Stay connected in {country} with a data plan that works the moment you land.
country.faqQ1: Can I use an eSIM if I also need my normal number?
country.faqA1: Yes. Keep your primary SIM active for calls and SMS, and use the eSIM for data. Set the eSIM as your mobile data line so you don't pay roaming charges.
country.faqQ2: What happens if the eSIM doesn't activate?
country.faqA2: Message our support team. If the eSIM was never installed, we can usually refund the order in full.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.installIphone: iPhone: Settings → Cellular → Add eSIM → Scan QR code.
checkout.installAndroid: Android: Settings → Network & internet → SIMs → Add eSIM → Scan QR code.
checkout.manualLpa: Or enter the LPA code manually.
checkout.guarantee: Full refund if the eSIM is never installed.
